column3: Calls the reset routines for pulse emitters, marker emitters, spark bursts, streaks, actor markers, number popups, model effects, and rings.
Calls the per-frame update and draw routines for all local effect pools.
Sets every timer in the eight-entry D_80086400 emitter pool to zero.
Allocates a D_80086400 entry, stores a position pointer, and starts its four-frame timer.
Ticks D_80086400 timers and spawns sprite particles on alternating frames at their stored positions.
Integrates the particle velocity, damps it, and sets size and alpha from age tables.
Clears the active fields of both eight-entry D_80086440 and D_80086500 marker buffers.
Accepts a position only when in the camera-facing half-space, then stores it in the current marker buffer.
Ticks the current marker buffer and periodically creates sprite effects at stored positions.
Moves and grows a sprite particle and derives its color and alpha from the environment and age table.
Copies the supplied position into a preset sprite descriptor and allocates a sprite effect.
Selects its image by age and sets size and alpha from lookup tables.
Clears the timers for all ten floating-number entries.
Allocates a timed entry for an actor, formats the absolute amount into digits, and records its display category.
Projects each timed actor to screen and draws the formatted digits above it.
Clears the active field of each D_800866D8 burst-emitter slot.
Allocates a D_800866D8 entry and stores duration, color selection, position, and radius.
Ticks burst emitters and spawns particles with randomized directions on alternating frames.
Moves and damps a burst particle, rotates it, and sets color and alpha.
Creates fifteen particles around the supplied point with randomized directions and the given radius.
Moves and rotates a burst particle, using 0.8 velocity damping and table-based color and alpha.
Clears the active count in each of the 32 D_80087298 streak entries.
Moves each active streak and draws a scaled, velocity-aligned model with fading alpha.
Allocates up to sixteen streaks at the supplied point and gives each a randomized outward velocity.
Clears the active field of all four D_800877A8 ring entries.
Allocates a ring and samples floor height and normals at sixteen rotated points around its center.
Sets an existing ring to its timed fade state and updates its center.
Updates ring lifetime and alpha, then draws sixteen connected segments along saved terrain points.
Clears the active field in the 32-entry model-effect pool.
Allocates a model-effect record and copies position, scale, animation, color, and texture descriptors into it.
Ticks all active model effects, configures color and texture, and draws each model hierarchy.
Builds a transform from a model-effect record and draws each root animation node.
Advances texture coordinates or frames and emits texture, combine, tile, and geometry commands.
Clears the active field in the four-entry actor-marker pool.
Billboards active marker sprites above D_8007AB48, scales by D_8007AA44, and fades their lifetimes.
Starts the indexed D_80087798 marker at a 25-frame lifetime.
Clears all 256 D_80087E38 sprite lifetimes and resets the active count.
Copies a descriptor into the first inactive sprite slot and increments the active count.
Ticks active sprite lifetimes, applies callback or display list, builds transforms, and draws them.
Selects the GBI texture load format and dimensions and configures its texture LUT.
